[Job Posting] Project Assistant (IDU_School Tour and Outreach School Tour)

The ASEAN-Korea Centre is seeking a Project Assistant (School Tour and Outreach School Tour) of ASEAN and Korean nationality to organize, coordinate and implement School Tour and Outreach School Tour programs* of the ASEAN-Korea Centre.

*The School Tour and Outreach School Tour are youth education programs designed to promote awareness of ASEAN and ASEAN-Korea relations through lectures and various other activities, held at the Centre or in schools across Korea.
About the Organization

The ASEAN-Korea Centre (AKC) is an Intergovernmental Organization mandated to promote economic and socio-cultural cooperation between Korea and the 10 ASEAN Member States. With a vision to build a lasting and genuine partnership between ASEAN and Korea, the programs of the AKC are geared towards increasing trade, promoting investment, invigorating tourism and expanding culture and people-to-people exchanges. The Centre is located in Seoul and the main language of operation is English and Korean. Please visit our website (https://www.aseankorea.org) for more information on AKC’s programs.
Job Description and Qualifications
(1) Job Description
Position
Duties and responsibilities
Expected start date
Project Assistant (IDU, School Tour and Outreach School Tour)
School Tour Project Assistant (IDU) is responsible for assisting the in-charge officer of the School Tour Programs in carrying out the following duties:
Plan and implement School Tour programs
Draft and prepare presentations and educational materials for School Tour programs
Assist communication to collaborate with Embassies to the School Tour programs
Acquire, organize, and manage resources at the ASEAN-Korea Connecting Lounge Information Corner and archive Centre’s publications
Handle inquiries from visitors
Support other PR/P2P programs and duties in IDU when necessary
December 2026
(2) Qualifications
At a minimum, a bachelor’s degree from an accredited academic institution

Relevant experience in community outreach, public diplomacy or related field in international (inter-governmental) organizations, national/international institutions, government organizations and/or private companies is preferred
Fluent communication skills in both English and Korean
Proficiency in MS office and video/photo editing skills are preferred
Should follow under Article 33 of the Public Officials Act and not be disqualified from overseas travel.
Employment Conditions
Employment Period: 6 months
Gross Salary per month: KRW 2,466,880 (includes lunch and transportation allowances)
Benefits: 4 Major insurances, Club activity, etc.
Starting Date: December 2026 (negotiable)
Working Hours: 09:00-18:00, Lunch hour: 12:00-13:00
Location: 8th fl., 124, Sejong-daero, Jung-gu, Seoul, Republic of Korea 04520
Selection Process
The recruitment process will be as follows:
1st round: Document review
* Must include a valid official English score (issued within 2 years).
* Please apply before the submission due date to prevent network congestion, and to ensure that your application has been successfully submitted.
2nd round: On-site English writing test and Interview

* The schedule is subject to change, according to the number of applicants and the recruitment progress. Those who passed the first screening will be notified individually and must arrive 10 minutes early for the interview and writing test with the ID card in hand.
* Virtual interviews are not permitted; candidates must attend an in-person interview.
Final result
The final result will be notified individually to the selected candidates
There will be a Health Screening process for the final candidate before the commencement date.
How to Apply
All applications will be received on-line via http://aseankorea.saramin.co.kr
Application Deadline: Until 23:59, 10 November, 2026
Applicants are fully responsible for the contents of their applications and may be disadvantaged if there are incorrect information/errors and omissions in the application.
For further inquiries, please contact: recruit@aseankorea.org
Documents to be submitted following final offer of employment
The documents below are to be submitted after the final offer
Graduation Certificate (or certificate of enrollment if not yet graduated)
Transcript of Academic Record
Career/Employment Certificate (if he or she has working experience)
Certificate for English Proficiency (Mandatory; must be valid within 2 years of the submission date)
In principle, TOEIC certificate should be submitted, but if not available, TEPS, TOEFL, IBT, G-TELP, FLEX and other English-speaking tests may be submitted.
Additional Information

In the event there has been an error in filling out the application form, the applicant will be subject to unfavorable consequences. If any grounds for disqualification (false allegations of qualification, health issues, etc.) is found, the Centre reserves the right to withdraw the notification of the final result, even if the results have already been announced.
For any cancellation of acceptance or disqualification of employment, the next highest scoring applicant may be considered for employment.
If, after the recruitment process, there is no suitable applicant, the Centre may decide not to make any employment offer and re-start the recruitment process.
